get.summary: Get all API keys for a newsletter
get.description: Returns all API keys of the newsletter. The raw key is not returned; only its metadata is.

post.description: Creates a new API key for the specified newsletter. The API key will be returned in the response, and it is important to store it securely as it will not be retrievable again.

201.description: Returns the created API key object. The `key` property is the raw key, which is only returned once.

post.description: Regenerates the raw key of an API key. The previous key is invalidated immediately, and the new raw key is returned once.

200.description: Returns the API key object with the newly generated raw key.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an API key. Requests made with the deleted key will be rejected immediately.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates the name, scopes, or enabled status of an API key.

200.description: Returns the updated API key object.

get.description: Get all subscriber exports of the newsletter.

post.description: Starts a new export of all subscribers of the newsletter.

200.description: Returns the created subscriber export object.

post.description: Uploads a CSV file of subscribers to import. Returns the parsed fields and row count so that the fields can be mapped before starting the import.

200.description: Returns the created subscriber import object.

post.description: Starts an import using the field mapping provided for a previously uploaded subscriber import file.

200.description: Returns the updated subscriber import object.

get.description: Get all subscriber imports of the newsletter.
Get whether the newsletter has reached its daily or monthly subscriber import limits.

200.description: Returns whether the daily and monthly import limits have been exceeded.

get.description: Get issues of the newsletter, paginated and ordered by most recently created.

post.description: Creates a new draft issue for the newsletter.

delete.description: Deletes a draft issue. Issues that are not in draft status cannot be deleted.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates a draft issue: its subject, content, sending profile, or lists.

post.description: Sends a draft issue to its subscribers. Validates the issue, license, and monthly email limits before queuing the send.

200.description: Returns the updated issue object, now in sending status.

422.description: Returned when sending the issue would exceed the organization's monthly email limit.

get.description: Get data useful for sending a test email of an issue: verified domains, and suggested and previously used test email addresses.

post.description: Sends a test email of a draft issue to the given email addresses. Test emails can only be sent to verified domains or emails of newsletter users.

200.description: Returns the number of test emails successfully sent.

get.description: Renders the HTML preview of an issue, and returns the number of subscribers it would be sendable to.

200.description: Returns the rendered HTML and sendable subscribers count.

get.description: Get the sending progress of an issue that is currently being sent.
Get individual sends of an issue, paginated and optionally filtered by search term or send type.
Get the delivery, open, click, bounce, and complaint counts of an issue.

post.description: Creates a new subscriber list for the newsletter.

delete.description: Deletes a subscriber list. Subscribers on the list are not deleted, only unlinked from it.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates the name or description of a subscriber list.

post.description: Uploads a media file to the given folder. Allowed extensions and size limits depend on the folder.

get.description: Get the current newsletter, as resolved from the API key used to authenticate the request.

delete.description: Deletes the current newsletter, as resolved from the API key used to authenticate the request.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates the current newsletter, as resolved from the API key used to authenticate the request.

get.summary: Get domains of the current organization
get.description: Get all sending domains registered by the current organization.

post.description: Registers a new sending domain for the current organization. The domain must be verified before it can be used to send emails.
Verifies the DNS records of a domain owned by the current organization.

200.description: Returns the verification result and the domain object.

delete.description: Deletes a domain owned by the current organization.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

post.description: Creates a new newsletter in the current organization.

get.description: Get all sending profiles of the newsletter.

post.description: Creates a new sending profile for the newsletter. The from email's domain must be a verified domain.

delete.description: Deletes a non-system sending profile of the newsletter. The system sending profile cannot be deleted.

200.description: Returns the remaining sending profiles of the newsletter.

patch.description: Updates a sending profile of the newsletter.

get.description: Get subscribers of the newsletter, paginated and optionally filtered by status, list, or search term.

post.description: Creates a new subscriber, or updates the existing subscriber if one already exists with the given email.

200.description: Returns the created or updated subscriber object.

get.description: Get a subscriber of the newsletter by email address.

404.description: Returned when no subscriber exists with the given email.

post.description: Resends the opt-in confirmation email to a pending subscriber.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.
Returns an empty object on success.

post.description: Performs a bulk action (delete, status change, or metadata update) on a set of subscribers.

200.description: Returns the result of the bulk action.

post.description: Creates a new subscriber metadata definition for the newsletter.

200.description: Returns the created subscriber metadata definition object.

delete.description: Deletes a subscriber metadata definition. Subscriber metadata values for this key are also removed.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates the name of a subscriber metadata definition.

200.description: Returns the updated subscriber metadata definition object.

get.description: Get the email template of the newsletter. If the newsletter has not customized its template yet, returns the default template string instead of a template object.

200.description: Returns the template object. If the newsletter has not customized its template, only the `template` property (the default template string) is present.

patch.description: Updates (or creates, if none exists) the email template of the newsletter.

post.description: Renders the given (or the newsletter's current) email template to HTML, using sample content.

get.description: Get all users of the newsletter.

post.description: Adds a HYVOR user (identified by `user_id`) who is already a member of the organization to the newsletter.

200.description: Returns the added (or already-existing, if `on_duplicate` is `ignore`) newsletter user object.

delete.description: Removes a user from the newsletter, identified by either its `id` or `user_id` (HYVOR user ID).

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.
